entities.summary: Giorgio Massari was an Italian late-Baroque architect from Venice. In Venice, he often worked closely with Tiepolo in planning interior decoration of palaces. Among his masterpieces are the Chiesa dei Gesuati (1726–43) located in Dorsoduro, Venice and the Palazzo Grassi (1749).
